mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2.5% annualized over the previous 3 months signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or CPIAUCSL annualized increase > 2.5% does not correlate with subsequent monetary tightening.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4% signals a tightening labor market, which increases wage pressures and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as companies invest in productivity-enhancing technologies.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or UNRATE < 4% does not correlate with subsequent productivity investments.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) over the previous 3 months signals strengthening demand in the housing sector, which is a leading indicator of broader economic growth and thus positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns do not show a significant positive trend following HOUST increases.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% month-over-month signals increased economic activity and supply-side strength, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or INDPRO MoM increase > 1% does not correlate with subsequent economic activity.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) and a decrease in unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals robust consumer demand and a strong labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or the joint increase in RSAFS and decrease in UNRATE does not correlate with subsequent economic growth.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) by more than 0.25% in a single month signals a shift towards accommodative monetary policy, which is expected to lead to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or FEDFUNDS decrease > 0.25% does not correlate with subsequent accommodative policy effects.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 200,000 in a single month signals strong job growth, which is a leading indicator of economic expansion and thus positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or PAYEMS increase > 200,000 does not correlate with subsequent economic expansion.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in GDP (GDPC1) by more than 0.5% quarter-over-quarter signals a weakening economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as investors anticipate reduced corporate earnings.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or GDPC1 QoQ decrease > 0.5% does not correlate with subsequent economic weakness.
